Text: Chuck is my go-to for anything related to college admissions trends, student success, workforce alignment, and student engagement. He brings deep knowledge to every conversation and, just as importantly, he’s someone I genuinely trust and consider a friend.  Our relationship goes back years—from his time at the University of Delaware to co-presenting together at NACAC and working with schools across the state. Chuck has an exceptional ability to connect strategy with what actually works for students, institutions, and systems. I consistently value his insight and perspective.
